description: This file contains Sass mixins related to Font Awesome icons, accessibility (screen reader only content), and visual transformations such as rotation and flipping for icons.

methods.name: fa-icon
methods.description: Mixin for styling Font Awesome icons with smoothing, display, and font properties.

methods.name: fa-icon-rotate
methods.description: Mixin to apply rotation to icons using degrees and rotation parameters.

methods.name: fa-icon-flip
methods.description: Mixin to flip icons horizontally or vertically with optional rotation.

methods.name: sr-only
methods.description: Mixin to hide content visually but keep it accessible for screen readers.

methods.name: sr-only-focusable
methods.description: Mixin to make screen reader only content visible when focused or active.
